category.title: Writing & Language
category.description: Practical browser-local tools for drafting, editing, and inspecting English text without sending content anywhere.

tools.title: Sentence Length Analyzer
tools.description: Measure sentence lengths and identify passages that may be tiring or abrupt to read.
tools.limitations: Heuristics use punctuation to find sentence boundaries and cannot judge meaning or intentional style.

fields.label: Text
fields.help: Use ordinary punctuation for best results.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

tools.title: Paragraph Cohesion Transition Map
tools.description: Map common connective words across paragraphs and flag paragraph openings that may need a clearer link.
tools.limitations: Presence of a transition word is only a proxy for cohesion; it does not assess factual or logical accuracy.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

tools.title: Active-Voice Pattern Checker
tools.description: Find likely passive-voice constructions and suggest a compact active rewrite pattern.
tools.limitations: The detector is a lightweight English heuristic and may flag legitimate passive voice or miss unusual forms.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: The report was prepared by the team. The editor approved the change.

tools.title: Pronoun Clarity Checker
tools.description: Flag sentences with multiple nearby noun candidates for a pronoun, helping you spot ambiguous references.
tools.limitations: This is a pattern-based warning, not a syntactic parser; context may make every flagged sentence clear.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: Maya told Jordan that they should revise it before Friday.

tools.title: Hedging Intensity Analyzer
tools.description: Count uncertainty and softening terms so you can decide where a claim should be more direct or more qualified.
tools.limitations: Words can be appropriate in context; the score does not determine whether a claim is true.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: This may perhaps be a useful approach, although it might need more testing.

tools.title: Rhetorical Question Finder
tools.description: Locate question-shaped sentences and classify likely rhetorical cues versus information-seeking questions.
tools.limitations: Intent is inferred from wording and cannot be known reliably without author context.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: Who does not want a clearer plan? What time does the review begin?

tools.title: Acronym Index Builder
tools.description: Extract repeated all-capital abbreviations and build a compact first-use index for a document.
tools.limitations: Initialisms in ordinary prose can be missed, and all-capital words such as headings may be included.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: The API uses JSON. Our QA team checks the API before release.

tools.title: Capitalization Consistency Checker
tools.description: Compare repeated words with different capitalization and report candidates for a consistent editorial choice.
tools.limitations: Sentence starts and proper names can legitimately vary; review each suggestion manually.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: The Project begins today. Later, the project enters review.

tools.title: Punctuation Spacing Cleaner
tools.description: Preview safe fixes for repeated spaces and incorrect spaces before common punctuation marks.
tools.limitations: Only conservative spacing patterns are changed; typography and intentional monospace formatting are not understood.

fields.label: Text
fields.placeholder: Paste text with punctuation spacing issues

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

tools.title: List Parallelism Checker
tools.description: Inspect comma- or line-separated list items for mixed opening forms such as verbs, nouns, and gerunds.
tools.limitations: The classifier uses leading-word patterns and cannot assess nuanced grammatical parallelism.

fields.label: List items
fields.placeholder: Put one item per line or separate with semicolons

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

tools.title: Abbreviation First-Use Checker
tools.description: Check a passage for uppercase abbreviations and flag first use without a nearby spelled-out form; this is a heuristic.
tools.limitations: It uses simple local patterns, cannot know every proper noun or official expansion, and requires editorial review.

fields.label: Abbreviations or names to ignore
fields.placeholder: Optional: API, NASA, or proper names to ignore
fields.help: Separate entries with commas or new lines.

testValues.text: Application Programming Interface (API) helps teams. The API can simplify work. Use QZK in the report.

tools.title: Number Style Consistency Checker
tools.description: Compare nearby spelled-out and numeral forms to reveal inconsistent number presentation.
tools.limitations: Context-specific style guides may intentionally mix forms, and only common number words are recognized.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: We reviewed three options and selected 3 finalists from twelve entries.

tools.title: Quote Punctuation Checker
tools.description: Inspect quoted sentences for likely missing punctuation inside or immediately after closing quotation marks.
tools.limitations: Quotation conventions differ by style guide and language variety; this tool does not rewrite dialogue.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: She said, "The draft is ready". Then he asked, "Is it final?"

tools.title: Homophone Context Flagger
tools.description: Find common homophone mix-ups such as their/there/they're and explain the basic distinction beside each occurrence.
tools.limitations: The checker flags words without understanding the full sentence, so correct uses may appear in the report.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: Their team left they're notes over there for review.

tools.title: US/UK Spelling Variant Auditor
tools.description: Detect common US and UK spelling pairs and show which variants appear so a document can follow one house style.
tools.limitations: The pair list is intentionally small and does not determine the audience’s preferred regional standard.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: The colour of the center is recorded in the catalog.

tools.title: Verb Tense Shift Scanner
tools.description: Scan sentences for mixed past and present-tense markers that may indicate an accidental narrative shift.
tools.limitations: Legitimate tense changes are common in analysis and instructions; markers are approximate rather than grammatical proof.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: Yesterday the team reviewed the draft and now they approve the final version.

tools.title: Sentence Variety Planner
tools.description: Classify sentence openings and lengths to show whether a passage relies too heavily on one repeated rhythm.
tools.limitations: Variety is a stylistic choice; the planner does not judge quality or recommend a single voice.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text: We planned the launch. We checked the files. We sent the update after lunch.

tools.title: Paragraph Balance Analyzer
tools.description: Compare paragraph word counts and sentence counts to identify unusually dense or underdeveloped sections.
tools.limitations: Uneven paragraphs can be intentional; density alone does not measure clarity or importance.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.text:
A short introduction.

This paragraph contains several sentences that develop the central explanation with supporting detail.

tools.title: Instruction Clarity Checker
tools.description: Evaluate procedural text for action verbs, ordered steps, and vague references that can make instructions harder to follow.
tools.limitations: The scores are editorial signals, not a usability study or a substitute for testing with real users.

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

testValues.instructions: First, open the settings. Then select the backup option. Do it there when ready.

tools.title: Claim & Evidence Gap Reviewer
tools.description: Count assertive claim cues and evidence cues to highlight paragraphs that may need support or qualification.
tools.limitations: Keyword counts cannot verify evidence, sources, or truth; review the flagged claims yourself.

tools.title: Call-to-Action Strength Checker
tools.description: Assess whether copy contains a clear action, an understandable object, and a useful time or next-step cue.
tools.limitations: The score reflects wording signals only and cannot predict conversion or audience motivation.

fields.label: Copy

fields.label: Include editorial suggestions
fields.help: Adds a short review prompt to the result.

tools.title: Meeting Summary Structure Builder
tools.description: Turn supplied notes into a structured local summary with decisions, open questions, and next steps detected from labeled lines.
tools.limitations: Only explicit labels and simple sentence cues are recognized; this does not infer missing decisions or owners.

fields.label: Notes
fields.placeholder: Use lines such as Decision:, Question:, Next:

tools.title: Reading-Time Segment Planner
tools.description: Estimate reading time and divide a passage into balanced word-count segments for review or publishing checkpoints.
tools.limitations: Reading time is an estimate based on the selected speed and does not account for complexity, skimming, or accessibility needs.

testValues.text: This passage contains enough words to demonstrate a simple reading-time estimate and balanced review checkpoints.

tools.title: Text Metadata Brief Builder
tools.description: Create a compact local brief containing word count, sentence count, headings, and an excerpt from supplied copy.
tools.limitations: Heading detection recognizes lines ending in a colon or short title-like lines; it is not a document parser.
